The description should be 'Follow-up meeting to discuss the project.'. The event should have the same participants as 'Introductory meeting' event on 2024-05-15.

```python
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Get the current date
current_date = get_current_day()

# Define the date for the event
event_date = "2024-05-19"

# Define the start and end times for the event
start_time_1 = "2024-05-19 10:00"
start_time_2 = "2024-05-19 16:00"

# Search for the 'Introductory meeting' event on 2024-05-15
introductory_event = search_calendar_events(query="Introductory meeting", date="2024-05-15")

# Get the participants of the 'Introductory meeting' event
if introductory_event:
    participants = introductory_event[0].participants
else:
    raise ValueError("Introductory meeting event not found")

# Check if the event at 10:00 already exists
events_at_10 = search_calendar_events(query="", date="2024-05-19")
events_at_10_at_time = [event for event in events_at_10 if event.start_time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") == start_time_1]

# Choose the start time for the new event
if events_at_10_at_time:
    start_time = start_time_2
else:
    start_time = start_time_1

# Calculate the end time for the new event
end_time = (datetime.strptime(start_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") + timedelta(hours=1)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")

# Create the new event
create_calendar_event(title="Follow-up meeting", start_time=start_time, end_time=end_time, description="Follow-up meeting to discuss the project.", participants=participants, location=None)
```
